table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	RowID,
	Date,
	RegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ECG.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ECG.PatientCode),
	FHName = (SELECT P.FName FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ECG.PatientCode),
	Age = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeYears))) + ' yrs ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeMonths))) + ' mon ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeDays))) + ' days ' FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ECG.PatientCode),
	Gender = (SELECT P.Gender FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = ECG.PatientCode),
	PatientCode,
	AdmissionCode,

	UserCode,
	AttendingDoctCode,

	ECG,
	ECGDate,

	WithinNormalLimit,
	WithinNormalLimitECG,
	NonSpecificFindings,
	NonSpecificFindingsECG,
	SymmetricalTinversions,
	SymmetricalTinversionsECG,
	AsymmetricalTInversions,
	AsymmetricalTInversionsECG,
	SignificantSTTChanges,
	SignificantSTTChangesECG,
	NonsignificantSTTChanges,
	NonsignificantSTTChangesECG,
	SignificantSTDepressions,
	SignificantSTDepressionsECG,
	NonSignificantSTDepressions,
	NonSignificantSTDepressionsECG,
	DynamicSTDepressions,
	DynamicSTDepressionsECG,
	SignificantSTElevations,
	SignificantSTElevationsECG,
	NonSignificantSTElevations,
	NonSignificantSTElevationsECG,
	SinusTachycardia,
	SinusTachycardiaECG,
	SinusBradycardia,
	SinusBradycardiaECG,
	BroadComplexTachycardia,
	BroadComplexTachycardiaECG,
	NarrowComplexTachycardia,
	NarrowComplexTachycardiaECG,
	LBBB,
	LBBBECG,
	RBBB,
	RBBBECG,
	LeftAxisDeviation,
	LeftAxisDeviationECG,
	RightAxisDeviation,
	RightAxisDeviationECG,
	CHB,
	CHBECG,
	AVDissociation,
	AVDissociationECG,
	AVBlock,
	AVBlockECG,
	BifascicularBlock,
	BifascicularBlockECG,
	TrifascicularBlock,
	TrifascicularBlockECG,

	ArrythmiasECG,
	VTECG,
	AFibECG,
	SVTECG,
	PSVTECG,
	WPWECG,
	VfibEcg,
	OtherECG
FROM 
	ECG
WHERE
	ECG.AdmissionCode = :ai_code
ORDER BY
	ECG.PatientCode,
	ECG.RowID DESC
